steps.title: Research existing patterns and plan approach
steps.description: Analyze requirements for "Full-Stack Retro Analytics Dashboard". Research best practices, existing patterns, and create a technical plan.

steps.title: Initialize project with Next.js and TypeScript
steps.description: Set up Next.js project with TypeScript, configure ESLint, set up folder structure.

steps.title: Design and implement database schema
steps.description: Create database models, migrations, and seed data. Set up ORM if needed.

steps.title: Implement authentication system
steps.description: Set up user authentication with JWT or session-based auth. Create login/logout/register flows.

steps.title: Build core API endpoints
steps.description: Implement main API routes with CRUD operations. Add validation and error handling.

steps.title: Create UI components and pages
steps.description: Build React components for the user interface. Create main pages and navigation.

steps.title: Integration and feature completion
steps.description: Connect all components, ensure data flow works end-to-end. Add any missing features.

steps.title: Testing and quality assurance
steps.description: Write unit tests, integration tests. Fix bugs and edge cases.
